backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining media uploads, live sessions, user profiles, comments, and access control with storage and authorization mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining legacy data types and a passthrough migration function returning the old actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping poll-related features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of key frontend components and pages.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment configuration file documenting required Internet Identity, canister, network, and admin settings.
frontend/docs/ic-mainnet-deployment.md: Deployment guide explaining prerequisites and steps to deploy the app to the IC mainnet.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining light/dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading the frontend app and mounting the React entry point.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Lists approved domains for canister domain validation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Initializes hash-based routing, splash screen logic, theme provider, and global route definitions.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper with navbar, footer, backend availability detection, and main content rendering.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Login/logout button component handling Internet Identity auth and clearing cache on logout or auth errors.
frontend/src/components/BackendUnavailab: Displays an alert when the backend is unreachable and provides reload and domain guidance.
Loads, displays, and posts comments for a media item with authentication checks and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Simple placeholder component showing an icon, title, and description when no content exists.
frontend/src/components/FloatingActionBu: Authenticated-only floating action menu for uploading videos, shorts, or starting a live stream.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: App footer with branding, navigation links, community info, and a credits section.
frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx: Top navigation bar with links, user info, and authentication controls.
frontend/src/components/PollCard.tsx: Renders a poll with options, percentages, vote submission, and authentication gating.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal that collects and saves a user's display name using a profile mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ShortCard.tsx: Displays a short-form video card with thumbnail, title, and duration linking to its watch page.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Full-screen splash image component shown during app loading.
frontend/src/components/UploadForm.tsx: Media upload form that validates title, file, type, duration, and sends upload requests with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders a video card with preview, duration, creation date, and link to the watch page.
frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx: Custom video player with play controls, seeking, volume, fullscreen, and imperative pause handling.
frontend/src/components/ViewerTimer.tsx: Timer component that counts down based on a user-set time range and triggers a callback when ending.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating media, profiles, comments, polls, and live sessions using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, CSS variables for theming, dark mode values, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the personalized feed, handles profile setup prompts, and displays videos or shorts with a loading and empty state.
frontend/src/pages/LiveDetailsPage.tsx: Displays metadata for a specific live session, handles ending a session if the viewer is the owner, and shows loading or error states.
frontend/src/pages/LivePage.tsx: Lists active live sessions and provides a form to start a new session, with profile checks and navigation handling.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Poll listing and creation page with authentication checks, dynamic poll form, and profile setup modal handling.
frontend/src/pages/ShortsPage.tsx: Displays all short-form videos in a responsive grid with loading state and empty state handling.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Authenticated upload page that shows a login prompt for guests and renders an upload form with profile setup enforcement.
frontend/src/pages/WatchPage.tsx: Media watch page that loads a video or short by title, shows metadata, handles errors, and displays comments.
frontend/src/types/poll.ts: Defines Poll type structure including ID, question, options, votes, timestamps, and creator.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and plugin setup for the frontend.
project_state.json: JSON file describing the current OmniStream project state, including goals, architectural notes, known issues, and implemented features. Used as the authoritative project-state record for build and deployment planning.
